articles.summary: Refinancing Extends Secured Debt Maturity to 2033 and Reduces Interest Expense Outlines Medium-Term Target for Leverage The RealReal, Inc. (Nasdaq: REAL) (the "Company"), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, today announced that it has entered into a credit agreement providing for a new $150 million senior secured term loan and a new $25 million senior secured revolving credit facility (collectively, the "New Credit Facilities"). The Company intends to use the proceeds of the term loan to redeem all of its outstanding 4.25%/8.75% PIK/Cash Pay Senior Secured Notes due 2029 (the "2029 Notes") at par. Funding of the term loan and redemption of the 2029 Notes are expected to occur on or about October 19, 2026. Funds managed by affiliates of Fortress Investment Group LLC ("Fortress") will fund the New Credit Facilities, which initially bear interest at SOFR plus 5.75%, subject to a leverage-based pricing mechanism, payable entirely in cash. articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL)—the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods—today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter, ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 29, 2026. The RealReal will host a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time) to review its financial results. A live webcast of the conference call will be available online at investor.therealreal.com . The archived webcast will be available shortly after the call at the same location. To access the live webcast, please register at this link: https://the-realreal-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net/ About The RealReal Inc. The RealReal is the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated resale luxury goods, trusted by a community of 45 million members.
